name: Hota Industrial Mfg. Co., Ltd.
summary: Hota Industrial Mfg. Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells automotive and motorcycle gears and shafts in Taiwan. The company offers rotor, link, and starter shaft; input gear, intermediate gear, output gear, park gear, and spool; differential; gearbox; balance shaft, sprocket oil pump, gear balance shaft, sprocket balance shaft, coupling pump drive, and shaft oil pump drive; fork and fork sleeve, output shaft and reaction internal gear, planetary gear set, shaft turbine, planetary carrier, and park gear; and torque converter component and transmission shaft.
